title: Video Editor- Stock Market
description:
About Us:  
We are looking for a **creative, detail-oriented, and technically skilled Video Editor** with experience in stock market, finance, and financial content.

The candidate will be responsible for creating engaging and informative video content related to **stock market news, trading, investing, IPOs, market analysis, financial education, and social media content**.

The ideal candidate should also have an understanding of **AI-based video creation**, including the ability to create videos using an AI-generated version of the presenter’s face, voice, background, graphics, and other visual elements.

Key Responsibilities

* Edit videos for **YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn**, and other digital platforms.
* Create engaging videos on **stock market, trading, investing, IPOs, market updates, and financial education**.
* Convert financial scripts and market research into visually appealing and engaging video content.
* Create videos using an **AI-generated version of the presenter’s face, voice, background, graphics, and other visual elements**.
* Use AI-based tools for **face/avatar generation, lip-sync, voice generation, image/video generation, and visual enhancement**.
* Add **charts, graphs, stock-price visuals, candlestick charts, animations, subtitles, transitions, and relevant graphics**.
* Edit short-form content such as **Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and social media clips**.
* Create long-form YouTube videos as well as short-form, high-retention content.
* Maintain consistency in **branding, visual style, tone, and overall video quality**.
* Stay updated with current **stock-market trends, financial news, and social-media video trends** to ensure relevant visuals and context.
* Coordinate with **content writers, researchers, analysts, and social media teams**.
* Ensure videos are **factually accurate** and follow applicable financial-content and platform guidelines.
* Manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality videos within tight deadlines.

Requirements

* **1–3 years of professional video-editing experience**.
* Prior experience creating **stock market, finance, fintech, or financial education content** is preferred.
* Good understanding of basic stock-market concepts, trading, investing, **NSE/BSE**, IPOs, and financial terminology.
* Proficiency in **Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve**, or similar video-editing software.
* Strong knowledge of **motion graphics, subtitles, transitions, sound design, color correction, and visual storytelling**.
* Ability to create both **long-form and short-form video content**.
* Good understanding of **social-media video formats, hooks, retention, pacing, and storytelling**.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work under tight deadlines.
* Ability to understand financial scripts and convert complex financial concepts into **simple, engaging visual content**.

Preferred Skills

* Experience working with **stock-market YouTube channels, fintech companies, brokers, financial educators, or investment platforms**.
* Understanding of **candlestick charts, technical indicators, stock-price charts, and market data**.
* Experience creating **financial infographics, chart animations, explainer videos, and data-driven visuals**.
* Knowledge of current **Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and social-media video trends**.
* Experience with **AI-generated presenter/avatar videos** is a strong advantage.
* Candidates with hands-on experience in **stock-market/financial video content** will be preferred.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who can combine **professional video editing + financial understanding + AI video creation** to produce high-quality, engaging, and modern financial content across multiple digital platforms.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented SEO Manager to lead our SEO strategy and drive organic growth. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of On\-Page, Off\-Page, and Technical SEO, along with the ability to manage SEO campaigns, analyze performance, and lead a team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with business goals.
* Manage and monitor On\-Page, Off\-Page, and Technical SEO activities.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and market research.
* Optimize website content, landing pages, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, and internal linking.
* Plan and execute link\-building and digital PR strategies to improve domain authority.
* Identify and resolve technical SEO issues related to crawling, indexing, site structure, page speed, and mobile optimization.
* Monitor website rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and other SEO KPIs.
* Analyze SEO performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other SEO tools.
* Create regular SEO reports and provide actionable insights to improve performance.
* Develop and manage SEO content strategies in collaboration with content writers.
* Stay updated with Google algorithm updates, SEO trends, and industry best practices.
* Conduct SEO audits and implement recommendations to improve website visibility.
* Manage, guide, and mentor SEO executives and team members.
* Coordinate with content, development, marketing, and other teams to achieve SEO objectives.
* Set SEO targets, track team performance, and ensure timely execution of SEO activities.

**Technical \& Professional Skills**

* Strong understanding of SEO principles and best practices.
* Excellent knowledge of On\-Page, Off\-Page, and Technical SEO.
* Hands\-on experience with Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
* Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms.
* Strong keyword research and competitor analysis skills.
* Good understanding of website architecture, HTML basics, and technical SEO.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Strong understanding of Google search algorithms and ranking factors.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration abilities.
* Good leadership and team\-management skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with different departments.
* Attention to detail and a result\-oriented approach.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new SEO trends and technologies.
* Strong presentation and reporting skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of relevant SEO experience, with prior experience in a leadership or managerial role preferred.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**Tell us where you fit the best,** **we will tell you how to get there…**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

We being an employee\-centric company, offers you a fun\-filled environment to excel in all the tasks you perform. Our endeavors aim to improve your learning curve so that you can gain a significant amount of life\-changing knowledge as you work with TOPS. We are looking for the skillful, hardworking and talented individuals who wish to cultivate cross\-functional abilities. If you think, you have strong fundamental values and forward thinking approach to stand apart from the crowd – we are here to help you!!!
  
### **Technical Content Writer**

Experience: 3\+ Years \| No of Openings: 2

  

Job Description


* Write service and landing pages, long\-form blogs, and case studies built on research and internal project demos not surface\-level summaries
* Attend walkthroughs and demos of delivered projects, ask the right questions, and turn what you see into a clear story of problem, approach, and outcome
* Own on\-page SEO for what you write: keyword research, structure, internal linking, meta descriptions
* Hand off publish\-ready drafts to the \[web/marketing] team, and flag existing pages that need refreshing
* Write campaign copy alongside the marketing team email, ads, gated assets
* Present drafts to the marketing team and, for major pieces, to founders; revise on feedback
* Keep voice and positioning consistent across everything we publish
Key Responsibilities


* 3\+ years writing for a technology company, software services firm, or B2B tech agency
* A portfolio of 3–5 published pieces you wrote start to finish, ideally including one case study or technical explainer
* Ability to sit through a project demo, follow what's happening, and ask the questions that produce a usable story
* Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and at least one research tool (\[Ahrefs / SEMrush / Search Console])
* Strong written English clean structure, no filler, minimal editing needed on a second draft
